ai.seo_question: What does 'the appointed day' (Yawm al-Waqt al-Ma'lum) refer to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the absolute precision of Divine decree (Qadr), emphasizing that the end of the world or the resurrection occurs at a moment known exclusively to Allah, reinforcing the concept of 'Tawqit' (fixed timing). It serves as a reminder for believers to remain vigilant and prepared, as the exact hour is hidden from even the angels and prophets, yet certain in its occurrence. This certainty provides spiritual comfort, assuring that no delay is arbitrary but part of a wise, pre-ordained plan.
